blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.
blocks.zh: 开发有效的机器学习模型需要复杂的人工调试,而目前的自动机器学习(AutoML)框架仍然是专有域并隔离模型架构,训练超参数,以及数据比优化. 在这里,我们通过提出一个通用的,基于大语言模型(LLM)的AutoML框架来弥补这一差距,这个框架将首次联合优化这些配置,而不需要针对特定任务的微调. 我们提出Ncode,一种统一的数字编码方案,将不同的AutoML设计选择转化为通用的离散序列,并有效地将优化过程重新设定为统一的排序任务. 拟议的基于LLM的搜索器仅就有限、单一领域愿景任务的优化轨迹进行了培训,展示了令人印象深刻的跨任务、跨模式和联合搜索-空间优化通用性,实现了跨图像分类、图像分解、语音核查和文本对图像基准的最先进性能。 关键是,它在大规模培训和联合优化十亿参数分解变压器时表现出了优异的可伸缩性,需要896个GPU日并达到最先进的GenEval分数0.91分. 通过利用强化学习来灌输思维链推理,我们提供了一种系统的方法来解释基于LLM的搜索者内部决策机制,揭示其优化战略从早期由多样性驱动的探索转向后期锚地开发. 我们拟议的框架提供了一个可扩展、可概括和可解释的途径,实现通用开放世界机器学习的优化。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Recent advancements in Machine Learning (ML) have revolutionized diverse domains, including computer vision, natural language processing, and audio analysis. Despite the progress, developing effective ML models remains a complex endeavor, often requiring extensive human experience in designing network architectures, tuning hyperparameters, and organizing training data. Consequently, Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) has emerged as a pivotal solution, aiming to automate such design choices of ML pipelines with minimal human intervention.
blocks.zh: 最近在机器学习(ML)方面的进步使包括计算机视觉,自然语言处理,和音频分析在内的多种领域发生了革命性的变化. 尽管取得了这些进展,但开发有效的ML模型仍然是一个复杂的工作,往往需要人类在设计网络架构、调整超参数以及组织培训数据方面拥有广泛的经验。 因此,自动化机器学习(AutoML)已成为一项关键的解决办法,目的是在最低限度的人力干预下,使ML管道的设计选择自动化。

blocks.en: While intensive explorations in AutoML have been made, particularly in Neural Architecture Search (NAS) for architecture design [ 57 , 58 , 31 ] and Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) for determining training hyperparameters [ 9 ] , the field still lacks a general-purpose AutoML framework. This gap has become increasingly challenging in the era of foundation models. Currently, the realization of such an open-domain system is impeded by three fundamental obstacles:
blocks.zh: 虽然在AutoML中进行了密集的探索,特别是在神经结构搜索(NAS)中对建筑设计[57,58,31]和Hyperparameter Optimation(HPO)进行了确定训练超参数[9]的探索,但是这个领域仍然缺乏通用的AutoML框架. 在基础模型时代,这一差距已变得日益具有挑战性。 目前,实现这样一个开放域系统受到三个基本障碍的阻碍:

blocks.en: • Open-world problem generalization. Existing AutoML approaches are typically optimized for specific search spaces, lacking the flexibility to generalize across diverse tasks, datasets and architectures. For instance, the popular gradient-based NAS method DARTS [ 31 ] achieves 97.24% accuracy on the CIFAR-10 test set within its original search space, yet suffers a severe performance collapse to 39.77% when evaluated on the widely used NAS-Bench-201 benchmark [ 12 ] . Even though both settings share identical dataset and optimizers, this sharp decline underscores the inherent fragility of current NAS and AutoML techniques when subjected to structural shifts in the search space. Consequently, this limitation hinders the application of AutoML methods in open-world problems that data distributions, architecture search spaces and task definitions are novel or unseen. • Intricate interdependence of model optimization choices. The optimal performance of a model is the result of the complex interplay between model architectures, training hyperparameters, and data ratios, etc. Such highly non-linear interactions are difficult to optimize in isolation. Existing AutoML methods fail to capture the synergies and often lead to sub-optimal local minima when components are optimized separately. • The prohibitive cost of AutoML training data acquisition. Creating AutoML training datasets is computationally expensive and time-consuming, as it involves the repetitive process of model training and performance evaluation for every new task. The high cost hinders the development and scalability of learning-based AutoML methods.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 开放世界问题概括. 现有的AutoML方法通常被优化用于特定的搜索空间,缺乏将各种任务,数据集和架构概括起来的灵活性. 例如,流行的基于梯度的NAS方法DARTS[31]在其最初的搜索空间内,CIFAR-10测试集的精度达到97.24%,但在广泛使用的NAS-Bench-201基准评估时,性能严重崩溃到39.77%。 尽管两种设置都共享相同的数据集和优化器,但这种急剧下降凸显出当前NAS和AutoML技术在受搜索空间结构变化影响时的固有脆弱性. 因此,这一限制妨碍了在开放世界中应用自动ML方法,因为数据分布、架构搜索空间和任务定义是新颖的或看不见的。 • 模型优化选择的相互依存关系错综复杂。 一个模型的最佳性能是模型架构,训练超参数和数据比等之间复杂相互作用的结果. 这种高度非线性的互动很难孤立地优化。 现有的自动ML方法无法捕捉到协同效应,在组件被单独优化时,往往导致局部微分不理想. ^ 获取AutoML培训数据费用高昂。 创建AutoML培训数据集在计算上既昂贵又费时,因为它涉及对每项新任务进行模式培训和业绩评价的重复过程。 高成本阻碍了以学习为基础的自动ML方法的发展和可扩展性.

blocks.en: To overcome these barriers, the field is witnessing a paradigm shift from specialized optimization algorithms toward more generalizable approaches. In particular, Large Language Models (LLMs) were leveraged to optimize AutoML problems to take advantage of their strong reasoning capabilities [ 54 , 29 ] . However, they remain heavily dependent on task-specific training, fine-tuning, and manual prompt engineering. As a result, there has been little deployment of AutoML frameworks that can navigate open-world problems spanning across multiple architectures, tasks, and modalities.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些障碍,实地正在目睹一种范式转变,从专门优化算法转向更通俗的办法。 特别是大语言模型(LLMs)被利用来优化AutoML问题,以利用其强大的推理能力[54,29]. 然而,它们仍然严重依赖具体任务的培训、微调和人工快速工程。 因此,很少部署能够解决跨越多个架构、任务和模式的开放世界问题的AutoML框架。

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce an open-world LLM-based AutoML framework that is capable of jointly optimizing the complex combination of model architectures, training hyperparameters, data ratios for different tasks without task-specific fine-tuning for the first time. To enable the optimization over the multiple intrinsically diverse search spaces, we introduce NCode, an encoding scheme that maps heterogeneous design choices to their respective indices, representing them as unified numerical sequences (Fig. 1 b,c). By converting diverse AutoML tasks into a universal discrete optimization problem, NCode allows LLMs to easily generalize to unseen open-world domains without domain-specific fine-tuning (Fig. 1 a). To train the LLM-based searcher, we curate optimization trajectories from the NAS-Bench-301 dataset [ 53 ] , which provides model architectures and their corresponding image classification performances on the CIFAR-10 dataset. We model the model arch instances as a densely connected Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and apply stochastic edge pruning to generate diverse, localized architecture search spaces for rich trajectory formulation. Furthermore, for the LLM-based searcher’s outputs, we reframe the discrete NCode optimization as a ranking problem, where the LLM identifies superior candidates from a candidate pool rather than directly predicting their NCodes, a setting demonstrated to be significantly simpler to learn than directly generating full NCodes. Consequently, despite being trained exclusively on single-domain vision data, our LLM searcher generalizes effectively to cross-domain joint optimization tasks where data collection is typically cost-prohibitive.

blocks.en: A preliminary version of our system that focused only on model architecture search was presented in EMNLP2025 [ 21 ] . The current study unveils the unified LLM-based searcher’s capabilities in significantly more complex, heterogeneous search spaces and mastering the synergy between model architectures, training hyperparameters, and data ratios across seven domains, four tasks and three modalities (vision, text, audio) without fine-tuning. More importantly, our LLM-based searcher is trained to explain its optimization rationales by learning explainable Chain-of-Thought (CoT) via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 39 ] . Our analysis revealed how the model navigates the solution space for optimization and offers critical insights. Extensive experiments provide compelling evidence and demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance across a diverse suite of open-world machine learning problems.
blocks.zh: 我们系统的初步版本仅侧重于模型架构搜索,在EMNLP2025 [21]. 目前的研究揭示了基于LLM的统一搜索者在更为复杂、多样的搜索空间方面的能力,并掌握了模型架构、培训超参数和七个领域的数据比率之间的协同效应,四个任务和三个模式(视觉、文字、音频)没有微调。 更重要的是,我们基于LLM的搜索者通过群体相对政策优化(GRPO)[39]学习可解释的思维链(COT)来解释其优化原理。 我们的分析揭示了模型如何引导优化的解决方案空间,并提供了重要的见解。 广泛的实验提供了令人信服的证据并表明,我们的框架在各种开放世界机器学习问题上取得了最先进的业绩。

blocks.en: We highlight our major contributions as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们强调我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. Unified Problem Representation: We introduce a universal numerical encoding that maps model architectures, hyperparameters, and data ratios into a unified discrete space, allowing the AutoML framework to jointly optimize diverse design choices across distinct search spaces. 2. Search Trajectory Curation: We introduce a pruning-based architecture sampling strategy to curate rich, diverse optimization trajectories, mitigating the prohibitive cost of AutoML data collection. By simultaneously reframing the LLM’s objective from direct sequence generation to conditional ranking, we boost the searcher’s capacity to generalize across complex optimization landscapes. 3. Extensive Empirical Validation: By deploying our approach across real-world machine learning tasks in diverse scenarios, and achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performances, we demonstrate the framework’s robust zero-shot generalizability. 4. Interpretability via RL-driven Chain-of-Thought: To unveil the internal decision-making mechanism of the LLM-based searcher, we leverage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to instill Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning without requiring human annotation. This self-explaining capability provides critical insights into the model’s learned optimization strategies, specifically revealing a dynamic shift from early-stage diversity-driven exploration to late-stage anchor exploitation, and highlights the inherent limitations of conventional discrete optimization methods in existing AutoML frameworks.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Traditional Automated Machine Learning
blocks.zh: II-A 传统自动机器学习

blocks.en: Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) has evolved significantly, progressing from early reinforcement learning [ 57 , 52 ] and gradient-based Neural Architecture Search (NAS) [ 31 ] to Transformer-based Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) [ 9 ] . More recently, the field has increasingly embraced advanced generative paradigms, such as leveraging multi-conditioned graph diffusion models [ 2 ] to sample candidate neural structures. Despite these advancements, conventional AutoML approaches remain inherently tailored to predefined, task-specific search spaces. Furthermore, even contemporary generative NAS models typically treat architecture search and training configuration tuning as disjoint problems. This isolation fails to capture the intricate synergies among heterogeneous components, restricting their applicability in open-world scenarios involving unseen modalities or structural shifts. In contrast to optimizing components in silos, our framework introduces NCode to unify these heterogeneous design choices into a shared numerical space, enabling holistic joint optimization.
blocks.zh: 自动机器学习(AutoML)有了显著的发展,从早期的强化学习[57,52]和以梯度为基础的神经结构搜索(NAS)[31]到以变形器为基础的超参数优化(HPO)[9]. 最近,这个领域越来越多地接受先进的基因模式,例如利用多条件的图扩散模型[2]来抽样候选神经结构. 尽管取得了这些进展,但传统的AutoML方法在本质上仍然适合预先确定的、针对特定任务的搜索空间。 此外,即使是当代遗传性NAS模型也通常把建筑搜索和培训配置调整视为脱节问题。 这种孤立无法捕捉不同组成部分之间错综复杂的协同作用,限制了它们在涉及看不见的模式或结构变化的开放世界情景中的适用性。 与仓房优化组件形成对比的是,我们的框架引入了NCode,将这些不同的设计选择统一为一个共享的数字空间,从而能够实现整体的联合优化.

blocks.en: II-B LLM-Based Automated Machine Learning.
blocks.zh: II-B LLM基于自动化机器学习.

blocks.en: Recent years have witnessed a growing interest in leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Automated Machine Learning (AutoML), with representative frameworks including AutoML-GPT [ 54 ] , LLMatic [ 33 ] , and CoLLM-NAS [ 29 ] . Despite these advances, existing LLM-based searchers suffer from key limitations: they either rely heavily on task-specific fine-tuning or formulate search as a direct textual generation task, which is prone to producing invalid configurations and exhibiting high learning complexity in vast discrete spaces. While our preliminary work, LM-Searcher [ 21 ] , initiated the exploration of cross-domain NAS via unified numerical encoding, it remained restricted to architecture-only search. To overcome these bottlenecks, the proposed framework unifies heterogeneous configurations into a discrete NCode space and reframes the search as a conditional candidate ranking problem. This design achieves robust zero-shot joint optimization of architectures, hyperparameters, and data ratios across diverse domains and modalities without task-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 近年来,人们日益关注利用大型语言模型进行神经结构搜索和自动机器学习,其代表性框架包括AutoML-GPT[54]、LLMatic[33]和CoLLM-NAS[29]。 尽管取得了这些进步,现有的基于LLM的搜索者仍然受到关键限制:他们要么严重依赖针对特定任务的微调,要么将搜索制定为直接的文本生成任务,这容易产生无效的配置,并在广阔的离散空间中表现出高难度的学习. 虽然我们的初步工作是LM-Searcher[21],通过统一的数字编码启动了跨域NAS的探索,但它仍然局限于只搜索建筑. 为了克服这些瓶颈,拟议框架将各种配置统一为一个独立的NCode空间,并将搜索重新设定为有条件的候选人排名问题。 这种设计实现了结构、超参数和不同领域和模式的数据比率的强力零射联合优化,而没有针对具体任务的调整。

blocks.en: II-C Explainability and Chain-of-Thought Reasoning.
blocks.zh: II-C 解释性和思维链 理性.

blocks.en: Traditional AutoML algorithms and neural search agents are frequently criticized for their black-box nature, providing minimal intrinsic rationale for their optimization trajectories [ 23 ] . While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting [ 43 ] and reinforcement learning algorithms like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 39 ] have boosted logical reasoning in LLMs, applying self-explaining CoT to interpret AutoML search logic remains under-explored. To bridge this gap, the proposed framework leverages GRPO to post-train the LLM-based searcher to articulate its reasoning steps in natural language. By taxonomizing the resulting CoT outputs into distinct behavioral patterns, we provide interpretability into LLM-driven optimization mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 传统的AutoML算法和神经搜索代理经常被批评其黑盒性质,为优化轨迹提供了最起码的内在理由 [23]. 虽然"思维链"(Cain-of-Thought (COT))所激发的[43]和"集团相对政策优化"(GRPO)等强化学习算法[39]在LLMs中促进了逻辑推理,应用自释自解的COT来解释AutoML搜索逻辑仍然没有得到充分利用. 为了弥补这一差距,拟议的框架利用GRPO在培训基于LLM的搜索器后,用自然语言阐明其推理步骤。 通过将由此产生的CoT输出分解成不同的行为模式,我们为LLM驱动的优化机制提供可解释性.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overview of post-training the LLM with CoT reasoning capabilities using Group Relative Policy Optimization. A Qwen3-8B model with native thinking abilities is fine-tuned on our curated dataset via reinforcement learning to articulate its reasoning paths. Given the system prompt, historical context, and candidate configurations represented as NCodes, the policy model generates multiple candidate responses. The total reward is calculated as a weighted sum of the accuracy reward (whether the model selects the optimal configuration from the candidate pool) and the format reward (whether the model outputs a complete reasoning process and the final answer in the correct format).
blocks.zh: 发相. 2: 利用集团相对政策优化法,对具有CoT推理能力的LLM进行后期培训. 一个具有本土思维能力的Qwen3-8B模型,通过强化学习,在被整理的数据集上进行了微调,以阐明其推理路径. 鉴于这一系统迅速、历史背景和以NCodes为代表的候选人配置,政策模式产生多种候选人反应。 总奖励额被计算为精准奖励(模型是否从候选人才库中选择最佳配置)和格式奖励(模型是否输出一个完整的推理过程和正确的最终答案)的加权和.

blocks.en: III The LLM-based Searcher framework
blocks.zh: 三. 基于LLM的搜索者框架

blocks.en: III-A Overview
blocks.zh: 三. A 概览

blocks.en: To enable the joint optimization of complex AutoML design choices including model architectures, training hyperparameters, and data ratios, we propose a universal, LLM-based open-world search framework. The core of our framework is a unified numerical encoding scheme termed NCode, which maps heterogeneous configurations into discrete sequences. During the search phase, the LLM-based searcher iteratively analyzes a historical buffer of evaluated NCode-reward pairs to autonomously identify and select the most promising configuration from an unevaluated candidate pool. Rather than relying on domain-specific finetuning, our LLM-based searcher is trained to implicitly learn optimization trajectories and reasoning strategies, allowing it to seamlessly generalize to unseen configurations and modalities.
blocks.zh: 为了能够共同优化复杂的AutoML设计选择,包括模型架构,训练超参数和数据比,我们提出了一个通用的,基于LLM的开放世界搜索框架. 我们框架的核心是统一的数字编码方案,称为NCode,将不同的配置映射到离散序列中。 在搜索阶段,基于LLM的搜索器迭代地分析被评价的NCode-wards对的历史缓冲,以便自主地从一个未评价的候选池中识别并选择最有希望的配置. 我们基于LLM的搜索器不是依赖特定域的微调,而是接受训练,以隐含地学习优化的轨迹和推理策略,使其能无缝地概括到看不见的配置和模式.

blocks.en: III-B Universal NCode Representation
blocks.zh: 三-B 通用NCode代表制

blocks.en: To unify the representation of heterogeneous AutoML design choices (e.g., model architecture, training hyperparameters and data ratios) and task domains, we uniformly encode all configurations into discrete numerical sequences termed NCode. Formally, let a given AutoML search space be denoted as 𝒮 \mathcal{S} . An AutoML configuration a ∈ 𝒮 a\in\mathcal{S} can be defined by a set of n n decisions, which may represent operational primitives, network connectivity, training module-specific hyperparameters or data ratios. We define an encoding function f : 𝒮 → 𝒞 f:\mathcal{S}\rightarrow\mathcal{C} , where 𝒞 \mathcal{C} is the universal space of NCode sequences. The function maps the configuration to a string of discrete indices, denoted as c = ( c 1 , c 2 , … , c n ) c=(c_{1},c_{2},\dots,c_{n}) , where each element c i c_{i} is a numerical index corresponding to a selected configuration option of the i i -th configuration.
blocks.zh: 为了统一不同AutoML设计选择(例如模型架构,训练高参数和数据比)和任务域的表述,我们统一将所有配置编码为被称作NCode的离散数字序列. 形式上,让给定的自动ML搜索空间表示为 S\ mathcal{S}. 自动ML 配置为 S\ a\in\ mathcal{S} 可以被一组 n n 决定所定义, 可能代表操作原始, 网络连接, 训练模块特定超参数或数据比 。 我们定义了编码函数 f: S → C:\ mathcal{ S}\rightarrow\ mathcal{C},其中 C\mathcal{C}是NCode序列的通用空间. 函数将配置映射到一串离散索引上,表示为 c = (c 1, c 2, ..., c n) c = (c_{ 1}, c_{ 2},\ dots, c_{n}),其中每个元素 c i = i}i} 是一个对应 i-th 配置的选定配置选项的数字索引.

blocks.en: NCode enables the joint states of model topologies, operations, training hyperparameters, and data ratios. To represent network topologies, networks can be modeled as Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs), where each edge represents an operation and each node represents a summed feature map. For instance (Fig. 1 b), in the NAS-Bench-201 search space, each architecture is defined by assigning one of five distinct operations to each of the six edges within a cell. The NCode representation establishes a mapping between these operations and a set of integers. Notably, by framing the search as a black-box combinatorial optimization problem, NCode natively extends to jointly encode other heterogeneous configurations. Fig. 1 c illustrates how NCode jointly encodes model architectures, training hyperparameters, and data ratios.
blocks.zh: NCode使模型地形、操作、训练超参数和数据比率成为联合状态。 要代表网络地貌,网络可以被建模为"定向环形图"(DAG),其中每个边缘代表一个操作,而每个节点代表一个概括的地物图. 例如(图1b),在NAS-Bench-201搜索空间中,每个架构的定义是,在一个单元格内,将五个不同的操作之一分配给六个边缘。 NCode表示法建立了这些操作与一组整数之间的映射. 值得注意的是,通过将搜索设定为黑盒组合优化问题,NCode本土延伸至联合编码其他异构. 发相. 1克说明NCode如何联合编码模型架构,训练超参数和数据比率.

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Pipeline of the subspace-sampled data curation strategy. Given an entire architecture search space modeled as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), stochastic edge pruning is applied to generate structurally diverse, localized sub-spaces ( 𝒮 s ​ u ​ b \mathcal{S}_{sub} ). Within each isolated sub-space, a subset of model architectures is sampled and evaluated to pair their unified NCode representations with corresponding performance metrics. To construct the training trajectories, these samples are partitioned into a sequential contextual history ( ℋ \mathcal{H} ) of evaluated trials and a pool of unassessed candidates ( 𝒞 \mathcal{C} ). This pipeline reframes the large-scale optimization problem into a tractable ranking task, training the model to select the candidate with the highest expected performance conditioned on historical context.

blocks.en: III-C Optimization Trajectory Curation
blocks.zh: III-C 优化轨迹校正

blocks.en: To effectively leverage LLMs as a general-purpose searcher for AutoML, we curated a dataset of optimization trajectories to capture the sequential, causal steps of iterative search processes. Specifically, each optimization trajectory comprises a sequence of AutoML configuration–reward pairs, with architectures represented by our unified NCode scheme. At each iteration, the search algorithm utilizes historically evaluated pairs as context to sample a new model architecture, which is subsequently evaluated to derive its performance metrics. A weighted sum of these metrics serves as the reward signal for the given architecture.
blocks.zh: 为了有效地利用LLMS作为AutoML的通用搜索器,我们整理了一套优化轨迹的数据集,以捕捉迭代搜索过程的相继,因果步骤. 具体地说,每个优化轨迹都包含一个AutoML配置的序列-奖励对,其架构由我们统一的NCode方案所代表. 在每次迭代中,搜索算法都利用历史评价的对子作为上下文来取取新模型架构的样本,而后经过评价得出其性能度量. 这些度量衡的加权总和是给定架构的奖励信号.

blocks.en: Instead of collecting AutoML joint optimization samples directly, which is time-consuming and computationally expensive, we sampled model-reward pairs from the established NAS dataset NAS-Bench-301 that includes approximately 10 21 10^{21} distinct model architectures with their performance on CIFAR-10 classification task. To augment the diversity of the architectural search space within our optimization data, we introduced a pruning-based architecture sampling strategy that generates varied sub-spaces from a single overarching search space. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , the comprehensive architecture search space 𝒮 \mathcal{S} is modeled as a fully connected DAG. We independently prune each edge with a probability p = 0.5 p=0.5 . This stochastic independent pruning inherently defines a localized sub-search space 𝒮 s ​ u ​ b ⊂ 𝒮 \mathcal{S}_{sub}\subset\mathcal{S} . Iterating this independent pruning generates a multitude of distinct sub-search spaces, yielding a training dataset with highly varied structural distributions.

blocks.en: Given the immense scale of the architectural search space, which comprises approximately 10 21 10^{21} architectures, identifying a single optimal architecture to serve as an absolute ground truth is computationally intractable and poses a significant learning challenge for the model. Consequently, we reframed the objective of the LLM-based searcher from direct prediction to candidate ranking. Within each isolated sub-space 𝒮 s ​ u ​ b \mathcal{S}_{sub} , we randomly sample a set of N N models (where N ∈ [ 100,200 ] N\in[100,200] ) alongside their corresponding performance metrics. The contextual history ℋ \mathcal{H} , comprising a sequence of previously evaluated NCode representations and their rewards, is provided to the LLM-based searcher. The model is then tasked with selecting the most promising NCode from a candidate pool 𝒞 \mathcal{C} of unassessed configurations sampled from the same sub-space.

blocks.en: Through this methodology, we curated a robust dataset comprising approximately 228,000 optimization trajectory instances. This extensive dataset boosts the LLM’s capacity to optimize AutoML configurations in a domain-agnostic manner.
blocks.zh: 通过这种方法,我们掌握了一套强有力的数据集,其中包括大约228,000个优化轨迹实例。 这种广泛的数据集提升了LLM以域不可知的方式优化自動ML配置的能力.

blocks.en: III-D Interpretability through LLM CoT Reasoning
blocks.zh: 三-D 通过 LLM CoT 可解释性

blocks.en: To unveil the LLM-based searcher’s reasoning process for AutoML optimization, we utilized Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 39 ] to fine-tune the Qwen3-8B [ 49 ] LLM as self-explaining searcher which learns to navigate the optimal AutoML configuration guided by its own CoT reasoning. We then analyzed the CoT reasoning explained in natural language on the NAS-Bench-201 [ 12 ] and GenEval [ 18 ] datasets, extracting its reasoning trajectories during the search phase for subsequent interpretability analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了揭开基于LLM的搜索者对AutoML优化的推理过程,我们利用了Group相对政策优化(GRPO)[39]微调了Qwen3-8B[49]LLM作为自我解释的搜索者,学习在自己的COT推理指导下导航最佳的AutoML配置. 随后我们分析了在NAS-Bench-201 [12]和GenEval [18]数据集上用自然语言解释的COT推理,在搜索阶段提取出其推理轨迹,用于后续可解释性分析.

blocks.en: Policy Optimization for AutoML Search. We cast the LLM-based AutoML search as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) designed to optimize decision-making trajectories within the universal NCode space. For a given search context x x (comprising historical trials and current candidates), the searcher acts as a policy π θ \pi_{\theta} that generates a token sequence y y representing the combined reasoning (CoT) and the final configuration selection. To efficiently navigate this complex discrete search space without the memory overhead of an explicit value network, we implement Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 39 ] . The reward for GRPO is a weighted sum of accuracy reward, verifying the selection of the optimal NCode candidate, and format reward, enforcing the structural integrity of the reasoning process required for interpretability analysis.
blocks.zh: 自动ML搜索政策优化. 我们把基于LLM的AutoML搜索作为Markov决策程序(MDP),旨在优化通用NCode空间内的决策轨迹. 对于给定的搜索上下文 x (包括历史试验和当前候选人) , 搜索者作为 \\\\\\theta} 的政策, 生成一个符号序列 y 代表组合推理( COT) 和最终配置选择 。 为了高效地导航这个复杂的离散搜索空间,而不使用一个明确的价值网络的内存管理,我们实施了集团相对政策优化[39]. GRPO的奖励是准确性奖励的加权总和,核查NCode最佳候选人的选择,以及格式奖励,强制执行解释性分析所需的推理过程的结构完整性.

blocks.en: Taxonomy of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Behaviors We employ LLM-based searcher with CoT capability to search on NAS-Bench-201 for image classification and GenEval for text-to-image generation. Experiments yielded 2,500 search steps complete with the model’s intermediate reasoning process on each task. To systematically analyze the searcher’s reasoning trajectories, we taxonomized the generated Chain-of-Thought outputs into six distinct behavioral patterns. The definitions of these patterns, as shown in Fig. 4 , are as follows:
blocks.zh: 思维理性行为的分类 我们使用基于LLM的具有COT能力的搜索器在NAS-Bench-201上搜索图像分类,并使用GenEval进行文本到图像生成. 实验产生了2 500个搜索步骤,完成了模型对每项任务的中间推理过程。 为了系统地分析搜索者的推理轨迹,我们把生成的思维链输出分解为六种截然不同的行为模式。 图4所示这些模式的定义如下:

blocks.en: • Positional Anchoring : This pattern occurs when the searcher explicitly identifies that the presence of a specific operational digit at a designated sequence position is strongly correlated with extreme (either high or low) performance outcomes. The LLM uses this single-point heuristic as an anchor for subsequent candidate selection. • Global Component Distribution : This applies when the searcher bases its decision on the global distribution of operations. The model observes that the aggregate count of specific functional digits across the entire configuration sequence systematically correlates with overall model performance, regardless of their absolute positions. • Neighborhood Mutation : We define this behavior as an evolutionary search strategy where the LLM selects a historically high-performing configuration as a baseline (“parent”) and targets candidates that represent minimal structural perturbations (e.g., modifying only one or two sequence digits). This reflects an exploitation tactic focused on exploring the immediate local optimum neighborhood. • Combinatorial Synergy : This describes instances where the reasoning process emphasizes the combinatorial interaction between multiple positions. The searcher identifies that specific multi-digit combinations (e.g., a coupled pair of operations at positions 3 and 5) yield a synergistic effect on performance that cannot be explained by individual digits alone. • Hierarchical Sequence Progression : This categorizes behavior where the LLM detects monotonically increasing or decreasing numerical patterns within specific sub-regions of the configuration string. The model interprets these ordinal trends as reflections of smooth or abrupt hierarchical transitions in the network topology that systematically impact the target metric. • Operational Heterogeneity : This pattern emerges when the searcher evaluates candidates based on their digital heterogeneity. By observing that high-performing models typically encompass a broader vocabulary of unique functional digits compared to homogeneous, underperforming ones, the LLM deliberately favors configurations that integrate a diverse array of numerical components.
blocks.zh: • 定位安抚: 这种模式发生在搜索者明确认定指定序列位置存在特定操作数字与极端(高或低)性能结果密切相关的情况下. LLM使用这个单点的heuristic作为后续候选人选择的锚. • 全球构成部分分配: 这适用于搜索者将其决定建立在业务全球分布的基础上。 模型观察到,整个配置序列中具体功能位数的总和与整体模型性能有系统关联,无论它们的绝对位置如何. · 邻接突变:我们把这种行为定义为进化搜索策略,LLM选择一个历史高性能的配置作为基线("家长")并针对代表最小结构扰动的候选人(例如只修改一到两个序列位数). 这反映了一种剥削策略,其重点是探索当地近期最佳街区。 • 组合协同:介绍推理过程强调多个立场之间组合互动的实例。 搜索者确定,特定的多位数组合(例如,在第3和5个位置的组合操作)对性能产生协同效应,单靠单个数位无法解释. • 等级顺序进展: 这分类了LLM在配置字符串的特定分区域内单调地检测到增减数值规律的行为. 该模型将这些正统趋势解释为网络地貌中平稳地或突然地分级过渡的反映,系统地影响目标度量. • 行动异质性: 这种模式在搜索者根据候选人的数字异质性评价候选人时出现. blocks.en: Fig. 5: Overview of our iterative LLM-based search framework. The training configurations encompassing hyperparameters, architectures, and data ratios are uniformly encoded as discrete numerical sequences named as NCodes. These NCodes are paired with their normalized performance metrics to serve as rewards, forming a continuously updated historical buffer of evaluated trials. During the search phase, a combination of an evolutionary algorithm and random search generates a pool of new candidate AutoML configurations. The LLM-based searcher analyzes the historical trials and identifies the most promising candidate from the candidate pool. The selected candidate undergoes training and evaluation, and the resulting performance metric is stored in the historical buffer. This iterative loop with NCodes is task- and domain-agnostic, enabling the LLM to zero-shot adapt to new AutoML domains without task-specific fine-tuning.

blocks.en: IV-A Overview
blocks.zh: 四. A 概览

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness, zero-shot transferability, scalability, and interpretability of our proposed LLM-based searcher, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations across four distinct machine learning scenarios. Specifically, we evaluate our framework on: (1) Cross-Domain Image Segmentation to test PEFT design and hyperparameter optimization under zero-shot domain shifts; (2) Cross-Modality Speaker Verification to assess cross-modal generalization from vision to audio; (3) Large-Scale Text-to-Image Synthesis to demonstrate joint architecture, hyperparameter, and data-ratio search at scale; and (4) NAS Benchmark (NAS-Bench-201) to verify standard neural architecture search performance. For each paradigm, we present the detailed experimental settings followed by the quantitative results. Furthermore, we investigate the interpretability of the LLM-based searcher’s internal decision-making process, supported by thorough ablation studies and qualitative case studies. Below, we first outline the common implementation details before detailing each specific task.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评价我们拟议的基于LLM的搜索器的有效性、零射入射的可转移性、可伸缩性和可解释性,我们对四种不同的机器学习情景进行了广泛的实证评估。 具体地说,我们评价我们的框架是:(1) 跨域图像分解,在零镜头域移位下测试PEFT设计和超参数优化;(2) 跨模式扬声器核查,以评估从视觉到音频的跨模式通用性;(3) 大规模文本到图像合成,以大规模展示联合架构、超参数和数据-比例搜索;(4) NAS基准(NAS-Bench-201),以验证标准神经架构搜索性能。 对于每个范式,我们提出详细的实验设置,然后是量化结果。 此外,我们调查了基于LLM的搜索者内部决策过程的可解释性,并辅之以彻底的弃权研究和定性案例研究。 下面我们首先概述共同的执行细节,然后详述每一项具体任务。

blocks.en: Implementation Details • LLM-based Searcher Training: To build the primary search agent, the LLaMA-3.1-8B base model [ 1 ] undergoes full-parameter supervised fine-tuning (SFT). The training is anchored on the curated dataset of approximately 228,000 optimization trajectory instances. To robustly capture expansive sequences of historical trial rewards alongside candidate configurations, we employ an extended context window with a strict token cutoff length of 20,480. The SFT process is executed for 3 epochs with a learning rate of 1.0 × 10 − 5 1.0\times 10^{-5} , regulated by a cosine learning rate scheduler following a 10% warmup phase. To ensure memory efficiency during full-parameter optimization, training is distributed across a single node equipped with 8 GPUs using the DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 framework in bfloat16 mixed precision, configured with a per-device batch size of 1 and a gradient accumulation step of 2. To analyze the searcher’s internal decision-making process, we post-train a Qwen3-8B model using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). For this reinforcement learning stage, we subsample 2,000 representative trajectory instances from the primary 228,000-instance dataset and execute policy training for 3 epochs. To facilitate relative advantage estimation within the algorithmic framework of GRPO, the policy model is configured to generate a group of 8 independent candidate responses for each individual prompt sample. The computationally intensive training is scaled across a distributed 4-node cluster equipped with 8 GPUs per node (totaling 32 GPUs), running the DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 framework with CPU offloading in bfloat16 mixed precision. The execution configuration utilizes a per-device batch size of 1 matched with a gradient accumulation step of 4. To mitigate the immense token overhead of long-form Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation while preserving search alignment, we employ Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) targeted at the attention projection modules ( q_proj and v_proj ). The maximum prompt and completion boundaries are constrained to 10,240 and 8,192 tokens respectively, allowing sufficient capacity for structural rationalization. A vLLM inference engine is colocated with the training framework to accelerate group-based relative reward sampling. • Search Phase: To initialize the AutoML configuration search within our framework, we utilized Random Search to sample and evaluate five configurations. This generated an initial set of five NCode-reward pairs for the LLM-based searcher to analyze. In each subsequent iteration, the LLM proposed an NCode, which was then decoded into a specific training configuration. To ensure computational efficiency during searches for image segmentation and speaker verification, we applied early stopping after a single epoch and used the partially trained model to derive a surrogate performance measure. For large-scale text-to-image synthesis, we jointly searched model architectures, training hyperparameters, and data sampling ratios using a surrogate model scaled down to half the block depth and hidden dimension size of the target model, with training truncated at 2,500 steps. The overall reward was calculated as the weighted average of all metrics and subsequently normalized across all evaluated configurations. Notably, for metrics where lower values denote superior performance, their contribution to the final reward was negated. Throughout the search, we maintained a historical buffer of up to 200 NCode-reward pairs. Once the evaluated pairs exceeded this threshold, we filtered the context provided to the LLM, retaining only the top-200 performing configurations. • Retraining Phase: Once the optimal configurations are identified by the LLM-based searcher during the early-stopping proxy evaluation, the selected configurations undergo a complete retraining phase for rigorous evaluation. Since these optimal configurations (encompassing architectures, hyperparameters, and data ratios) represent the direct outcomes of our search process, the specific retraining implementation details are inherently task-specific. Therefore, we detail the complete retraining setups within the respective Search Configuration sections of each task (Sections IV-B – IV-D ).

blocks.en: LLM-based Searcher Training: To build the primary search agent, the LLaMA-3.1-8B base model [ 1 ] undergoes full-parameter supervised fine-tuning (SFT). The training is anchored on the curated dataset of approximately 228,000 optimization trajectory instances. To robustly capture expansive sequences of historical trial rewards alongside candidate configurations, we employ an extended context window with a strict token cutoff length of 20,480. The SFT process is executed for 3 epochs with a learning rate of 1.0 × 10 − 5 1.0\times 10^{-5} , regulated by a cosine learning rate scheduler following a 10% warmup phase. To ensure memory efficiency during full-parameter optimization, training is distributed across a single node equipped with 8 GPUs using the DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 framework in bfloat16 mixed precision, configured with a per-device batch size of 1 and a gradient accumulation step of 2.

blocks.en: To analyze the searcher’s internal decision-making process, we post-train a Qwen3-8B model using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). For this reinforcement learning stage, we subsample 2,000 representative trajectory instances from the primary 228,000-instance dataset and execute policy training for 3 epochs. To facilitate relative advantage estimation within the algorithmic framework of GRPO, the policy model is configured to generate a group of 8 independent candidate responses for each individual prompt sample. The computationally intensive training is scaled across a distributed 4-node cluster equipped with 8 GPUs per node (totaling 32 GPUs), running the DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 framework with CPU offloading in bfloat16 mixed precision. The execution configuration utilizes a per-device batch size of 1 matched with a gradient accumulation step of 4. The maximum prompt and completion boundaries are constrained to 10,240 and 8,192 tokens respectively, allowing sufficient capacity for structural rationalization. A vLLM inference engine is colocated with the training framework to accelerate group-based relative reward sampling.

blocks.en: Search Phase: To initialize the AutoML configuration search within our framework, we utilized Random Search to sample and evaluate five configurations. This generated an initial set of five NCode-reward pairs for the LLM-based searcher to analyze. In each subsequent iteration, the LLM proposed an NCode, which was then decoded into a specific training configuration. To ensure computational efficiency during searches for image segmentation and speaker verification, we applied early stopping after a single epoch and used the partially trained model to derive a surrogate performance measure. For large-scale text-to-image synthesis, we jointly searched model architectures, training hyperparameters, and data sampling ratios using a surrogate model scaled down to half the block depth and hidden dimension size of the target model, with training truncated at 2,500 steps. The overall reward was calculated as the weighted average of all metrics and subsequently normalized across all evaluated configurations. Notably, for metrics where lower values denote superior performance, their contribution to the final reward was negated. Throughout the search, we maintained a historical buffer of up to 200 NCode-reward pairs. Once the evaluated pairs exceeded this threshold, we filtered the context provided to the LLM, retaining only the top-200 performing configurations.

blocks.en: • Datasets. To evaluate the cross-task and cross-domain generalizability of our proposed LLM-based searcher, we utilized a diverse suite of image segmentation datasets encompassing multiple distinct domains. The search phase was conducted in the medical imaging domain using the Kvasir-SEG and CVC-612 datasets. Specifically, Kvasir-SEG and CVC-612 evaluate the model’s capability in gastrointestinal polyp segmentation using endoscopic and colonoscopy imagery, respectively. To test zero-shot transferability, the optimal configuration discovered during search was evaluated on seven datasets across domains. In addition to the two datasets, these include ISIC2017, which focuses on the precise boundary delineation of skin lesions for melanoma detection; CAMO, which features natural imagery of camouflaged objects that artfully blend into their surroundings; SBU, which tasks the model with differentiating true structural boundaries from complex shadow masks in everyday scenes; Leaf, an agricultural dataset focused on delineating individual plant leaves from overlapping foliage backgrounds; and Road, which utilizes high-resolution remote sensing imagery to evaluate the extraction of continuous topological road networks across vast landscapes. • Search Configuration. The search space comprises both model architectures and training hyperparameters. For architecture, we used the Segment Anything Model (SAM) as the base segmenter and searched the PEFT design by assigning the ranks of 32 LoRA modules in the ViT encoder from { 3 , 6 , 12 , 24 } \{3,6,12,24\} , yielding a search space of approximately 10 19 10^{19} architectures. The hyperparameter search space incorporates the focal loss γ \gamma , weight decay, and learning rate. To efficiently navigate this expansive space, we implement an early-stopping proxy evaluation protocol during the search phase, where each candidate configuration is trained for only 1 epoch to derive a surrogate reward. The discovered optimal configuration is subsequently subjected to full retraining for 30 epochs, establishing a highly efficient search-to-full-training workload ratio of 1:30. Comprehensive details regarding the search space are provided in Appendix Table 1. For the subsequent retraining phase, we applied the identified best-performing AutoML configurations to each downstream dataset. Specifically, we fine-tuned the Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 25 ] using our optimal LoRA [ 20 ] configuration. Training was conducted on a single GPU, utilizing a global batch size of 4, a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , a weight decay of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , and a γ \gamma value of 2.0. • Evaluation Metrics. To comprehensively assess the zero-shot transferability of the searched configurations across diverse target domains, we employ a multi-faceted evaluation protocol tailored to the morphological characteristics of each dataset. For all metrics except the Balanced Error Rate (BER), higher values indicate superior performance. – Structural and Alignment Metrics: For datasets requiring strict foreground object consistency and structural integrity (Kvasir-SEG, CVC-612, and CAMO), we utilize the S-measure ( S α S_{\alpha} ) [ 14 ] and Enhanced-alignment measure ( E ϕ E_{\phi} ) [ 15 ] . – Spatial Overlap and Region Metrics: For tasks where exact spatial overlap is the most critical success factor (ISIC2017, Leaf, and Road), we rely on the widely adopted Jaccard Index (Jac). Additionally, the weighted F-measure ( F β ω F_{\beta}^{\omega} ) is evaluated across multiple datasets to adaptively emphasize errors in highly salient regions. – Balanced Error Metrics: The Balanced Error Rate (BER) is specifically applied to evaluate the performance on the SBU dataset. It ensures an unbiased assessment for shadow detection by equally weighting the classification error rates of both shadow and non-shadow regions. Detailed mathematical formulations for all the aforementioned evaluation metrics are provided in Appendix Section 2.

blocks.en: • Datasets. We validated the cross-modality generalization capability of our LLM-based searcher on the audio modality evaluation suite 3D-Speaker-Toolkit [ 8 ] . The 3D-Speaker corpus is a large-scale dataset containing over 10,000 speakers, which are partitioned into training and test sets. We evaluated the models across three challenging tracks: multi-device, multi-distance, and multi-dialect. The evaluation split comprises 240 unseen speakers, 18,782 utterances, 11 dialects, and 15.42 hours of speech. • Search Configuration. Our framework navigates a comprehensive search space that comprises both model architectures and training hyperparameters for the speaker verification task. The architectural search space dictates the model’s capacity and feature resolution, specifically targeting the Mel-filterbank input dimensions, the base channel width of the ERes2NetV2 backbone, and the final speaker embedding size. Concurrently, the hyperparameter search space includes the data augmentation probability, learning rate, optimizer momentum, and weight decay. To maintain computational efficiency across this joint space, we implement an early-stopping proxy evaluation protocol during the search phase, truncating each candidate’s training at only 1 epoch to derive a surrogate reward. The discovered optimal configuration is subsequently subjected to full retraining for a total of 77 epochs—comprising 70 epochs of standard training followed by a 7-epoch large-margin fine-tuning stage—establishing a highly efficient search-to-full-training workload ratio of approximately 1:77. The exact search space for each design choice is detailed in Appendix Table 1. For the retraining phase, the optimal model architecture was trained on the 3D-Speaker-Toolkit dataset for 70 epochs. We employed a cosine learning rate scheduler with an initial learning rate of 0.3, a weight decay of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , a momentum of 0.85, and a data augmentation probability of 0.4. The resulting model was subsequently fine-tuned utilizing a large-margin strategy for an additional seven epochs, maintaining the same hyperparameter settings. • Evaluation Metrics. We assessed the performance of the discovered configurations utilizing two standard metrics within the speaker verification domain: the Equal Error Rate (EER) and the minimum of the normalized detection cost function (minDCF). For both metrics, lower values signify superior detection and recognition performance. The optimal configuration was fully retrained and evaluated across five independent runs, from which we report the mean and standard deviation.

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Experimental Setting
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 实验设置

blocks.en: • Heterogeneous Training Corpus. To train the DiT model, we constructed a diverse image-text corpus and dynamically search for the optimal data distribution ratios during training. This corpus amalgamates several high-quality datasets, each providing image-caption pairs with unique visual-semantic priors: – BLIP3o (Short, Long, JourneyDB, and 60k variants) [ 4 ] : Provides highly descriptive, synthetically enriched captions that enhance fine-grained semantic alignment. – LAION-high-resolution [ 38 ] : A large-scale, web-scraped dataset ensuring broad coverage of real-world concepts and natural image distributions. – Midjourney-23m-2 : Comprises high-fidelity, artistically curated synthetic images to elevate the overall aesthetic quality of the generated outputs. – X2I2 [ 45 ] : A dataset designed to improve complex instruction-guided generation. – Echo-4o [ 50 ] : A synthetic dataset generated by GPT-4o, providing clean supervision to complement rare scenarios and complex compositions less represented in real-world data. • Search Configuration. Our LLM-based searcher navigates a unified configuration space to jointly optimize the model architecture, training hyperparameters, and data sampling ratios. Architecturally, we adopt the MM-DiT as the foundational backbone, searching over the hidden dimension size, as well as the depths of the single- and double-stream blocks. The hyperparameter search space encompasses the learning rate, weight decay, and the optimizer parameters β \beta and ϵ \epsilon . Finally, to optimize the training data composition, the sampling weight for each dataset during training is independently tuned within a range of 1.0 to 6.0. To scale this framework to the immense computational demands of large-scale pre-training, we execute the search phase using a surrogate model scaled down to half the block depth and hidden dimension size of the target model, with training truncated at 2,500 steps. The optimal configuration is then scaled up to the full 1.3-billion-parameter architecture and trained for a total of 100,000 steps across three distinct resource-intensive stages, establishing a highly efficient search-to-full-training step ratio of approximately 1:40. Detailed descriptions of the search space are provided in Appendix Table 3. For the full retraining phase, we conducted a large-scale pre-training experiment, training a 1.3-billion-parameter model across 128 GPUs for approximately seven days. The training process consisted of three stages. In the first stage, all training images were resized to a 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. The model was trained for 85,000 steps on BLIP3o-JourneyDB, BLIP3o-Long, BLIP3o-Short, LAION-high-resolution, Midjourney-23m-2, and X2I2, with data sampling ratios of 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0, 1.0, and 4.0, respectively. We utilized a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , a β 2 \beta_{2} parameter of 0.99, an ϵ \epsilon of 1 × 10 − 15 1\times 10^{-15} , and a weight decay of 0.1. In the second stage, we scaled the image resolution to 512 × 512 512\times 512 and continually trained the model for 5,000 steps using identical hyperparameters and data ratios. Finally, the model was fine-tuned on the BLIP3o-60k and Echo-4o datasets for 10,000 steps. • Evaluation Metrics. We benchmarked the optimized DiT model using GenEval [ 18 ] to rigorously assess fine-grained compositional alignment at the instance level. We systematically evaluated the model across fundamental visual primitives, including single/multi-object rendering, object counting, spatial positioning, coloring, and attribute binding. The overall GenEval score is reported as the unweighted macro-average of the accuracies across these distinct sub-tasks, ensuring equal evaluation weight for each compositional skill. For evaluation, we generate four samples per prompt using an inference step number of 50 and a Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance (CFG) scale of 5.0.

blocks.en: Search Configuration. Our LLM-based searcher navigates a unified configuration space to jointly optimize the model architecture, training hyperparameters, and data sampling ratios. Architecturally, we adopt the MM-DiT as the foundational backbone, searching over the hidden dimension size, as well as the depths of the single- and double-stream blocks. The hyperparameter search space encompasses the learning rate, weight decay, and the optimizer parameters β \beta and ϵ \epsilon . Finally, to optimize the training data composition, the sampling weight for each dataset during training is independently tuned within a range of 1.0 to 6.0. To scale this framework to the immense computational demands of large-scale pre-training, we execute the search phase using a surrogate model scaled down to half the block depth and hidden dimension size of the target model, with training truncated at 2,500 steps. The optimal configuration is then scaled up to the full 1.3-billion-parameter architecture and trained for a total of 100,000 steps across three distinct resource-intensive stages, establishing a highly efficient search-to-full-training step ratio of approximately 1:40. Detailed descriptions of the search space are provided in Appendix Table 3. For the full retraining phase, we conducted a large-scale pre-training experiment, training a 1.3-billion-parameter model across 128 GPUs for approximately seven days. The training process consisted of three stages. In the first stage, all training images were resized to a 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. The model was trained for 85,000 steps on BLIP3o-JourneyDB, BLIP3o-Long, BLIP3o-Short, LAION-high-resolution, Midjourney-23m-2, and X2I2, with data sampling ratios of 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0, 1.0, and 4.0, respectively. We utilized a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , a β 2 \beta_{2} parameter of 0.99, an ϵ \epsilon of 1 × 10 − 15 1\times 10^{-15} , and a weight decay of 0.1. In the second stage, we scaled the image resolution to 512 × 512 512\times 512 and continually trained the model for 5,000 steps using identical hyperparameters and data ratios. Finally, the model was fine-tuned on the BLIP3o-60k and Echo-4o datasets for 10,000 steps.

blocks.en: Table IV-C2 illustrates the performance comparison between our optimized DiT model and established text-to-image synthesis works on the GenEval [ 18 ] metric. Notably, our approach achieves the highest GenEval score of 0.91 compared with existing state-of-the-art methods. We also benchmarked our approach against another AutoML method, OptFormer [ 9 ] , within the identical search space, outperforming it by an absolute margin of 0.07. Moreover, our model demonstrates remarkable parameter and data efficiency: despite comprising only 1.3 billion parameters and being trained on merely 50 billion tokens, it exceeds the performance of the 20-billion-parameter Qwen-Image model by 0.04. Furthermore, it surpasses the BAGEL model, which relies on 7 billion parameters and a massive 5 trillion training tokens, by a margin of 0.03 (Fig. 6 ). These findings underscore the robust generalization capability and scalability of our method in large-scale machine learning training scenarios.

blocks.en: • Datasets. While traditional NAS methods are highly specialized for image classification tasks, we benchmark our approach on NAS-Bench-201 to verify that our domain-agnostic LLM-based searcher matches their performance in standard image classification, serving as a prerequisite for our open-world AutoML evaluations. Every architecture within the NAS-Bench-201 search space has been fully trained and evaluated across three distinct image classification datasets: CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-16-120. By querying this predefined dataset, we bypass the immense computational overhead of repetitively training candidate architectures from scratch. • Search Space Configuration. NAS-Bench-201 offers an algorithm-agnostic, fixed search space based on a neural cell topology represented as a DAG. The cell architecture comprises four nodes and five predefined operation options (zeroize, skip connection, 1-by-1 convolution, 3-by-3 convolution, and 3-by-3 average pooling), which yields a comprehensive search space of 15,625 unique neural architecture candidates. • Evaluation Protocol. We executed five independent search trials of 200 steps per dataset. The reported metrics represent the average classification accuracy across the five top-tier architectures, each selected based on the highest validation accuracy attained during its individual run.

NAS-Bench-201搜索空间内的每一个架构都经过了全面培训和评价,跨越了三个不同的图像分类数据集:CIFAR-10,CIFAR-100和ImageNet-16-120. 通过查询这个预先定义的数据集, 我们绕过了从零开始重复培训候选架构的巨大计算间接费用。 • 搜索空间配置。 NAS-Bench-201提供了一个基于神经细胞地貌作为DAG代表的算法-可知性,固定的搜索空间. 细胞架构由4个节点和5个被预先定义的操作选项(零化,跳过连接,一相一分化,3相3分化,和3相3相一平均集合)组成,它产生了15,625个独特的神经架构候选者的综合搜索空间. • 评价议定书。 我们进行了五次独立搜索试验,每个数据集有200个步骤。 所报告的衡量标准是五个顶级结构的平均分类准确性,每个结构都是根据在单个运行期间达到的最高验证准确性选定的。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Table IV , our proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates highly competitive performance across the CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-16-120 datasets without any task-specific fine-tuning. Although our framework is designed as a general-purpose, open-world optimizer rather than an architecture-specialized NAS algorithm, it yields performance highly comparable to state-of-the-art specialized methods. Specifically, on ImageNet16-120, our zero-shot searcher achieves a test accuracy of 46.51%, noticeably outperforming the top conventional NAS baseline DiNAS [ 2 ] (45.41%) as well as earlier LLM-based searchers such as LLMatic [ 33 ] (45.87%) and GENIUS [ 55 ] (44.96%), while performing closely on par with the specialized CoLLM-NAS [ 29 ] (46.79%). These results confirm that our task-agnostic paradigm retains strong search efficiency on standard architectural benchmarks, providing a solid prerequisite for multi-modal open-world AutoML tasks.

blocks.en: To unveil the proposed LLM-based searcher’s reasoning process in optimizing heterogeneous AutoML configurations, we post-train a Qwen3-8B model with CoT capabilities using our curated optimization trajectory dataset with GRPO (Fig. 2 ). Crucially, as validated in our ablation studies (Section IV-G ), this Qwen3-8B-based searcher exhibits performance parity with our primary LLaMA-3.1-8B backbone, establishing it as a faithful proxy to decode the framework’s decision-making logic. We employed the LLM-based searcher with CoT capability to search for image classification on NAS-Bench-201 and text-to-image synthesis on GenEval, generating optimization trajectories alongside natural language reasoning processes for explainability. These “reasoning processes” were then taxonomized using Gemini-2.5-Pro to identify six major optimization strategies learned by the LLM-based searcher (Fig. 7 ): Positional Anchoring (e.g., fixing high-performing digit at critical position), Combinatorial Synergy (e.g., combinational effect of digits across positions), Neighborhood Mutation (e.g., making slight perturbations on evaluated NCode), Global Component Distribution (e.g., tracking the occurrence of specific digit), Hierarchical Sequence Progression (increasing/decreasing trends at local regions) and Operational Heterogeneity (diversity of digits in NCodes).
blocks.zh: 为了揭开基于LLM的搜索者在优化多样化的自动ML配置时的推理过程,我们利用我们用GRPO(图2)的优化轨迹数据集,对具有CoT能力的Quen3-8B模型进行培训。 关键是,正如我们的研究(第四至G节)所证实的那样,这个基于Quen3-8B的搜索器与我们的主要LLaMA-31-8B骨干显示性能均等,并确立它是一个忠实的代名词来解码框架的决策逻辑。 我们利用了基于LLM的具有COT功能的搜索器,在NAS-Bench-201上搜索图像分类,并在GenEval上搜索文本到图像的合成,从而产生与自然语言推理过程并行的优化轨迹,以进行解释. 这些“合理过程”然后使用双子2.5-Pro进行分类,以确定基于LLM的搜索者所学到的六项主要优化战略(图7):定位安打(如在临界位置固定高性能数字)、组合协同(如数字跨位置的组合效应)、邻接突变(如对评价的NCode稍作干扰)、全球组件分布(如跟踪特定数字的出现)、分级顺序递减(局部地区增长/下降趋势)和业务异源性(NCodes数字的多样性)。

blocks.en: IV-F 2 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 实验结果

blocks.en: Subsequent analysis of strategy distributions, state transitions, and temporal dynamics reveals that the LLM intrinsically develops a sophisticated exploration-exploitation paradigm, progressively shifting from broad structural exploration to the greedy exploitation of key architectural anchors.
blocks.zh: 随后对战略分布,状态过渡和时间动态的分析表明,LLM内在地发展出一种精密的探索-开发范式,由广泛的结构探索逐渐转向对关键建筑锚地的贪婪利用.

blocks.en: Analyzing the temporal evolution of these reasoning patterns unveils a reasonable search logic rather than a random application of strategies (Fig. 7 ). Initially, the searcher predominantly employs Neighborhood Mutation to navigate the configuration space, selecting candidate NCodes that introduce localized structural perturbations to historically high-performing baselines. As the search progresses, the probability of utilizing this Neighborhood Mutation gradually diminishes, giving way to exploitative patterns that leverage historical context. Crucially, this transition adapts to the complexity of the target task. On the simpler NAS-Bench-201 image classification benchmark, the searcher gradually shifts to the Positional Anchoring strategy, indicating a learned tendency to fix specific, high-yielding modules at critical topological positions. Conversely, on the highly complex GenEval text-to-image synthesis task, the model gradually shifts toward Combinatorial Synergy. By focusing on multi-digit patterns within NCodes, it demonstrates an ability to untangle the intricate combinatorial effects of heterogeneous configurations.
blocks.zh: 分析这些推理模式的时间演变揭示出一种合理的搜索逻辑,而不是策略的随机应用(图7. 最初,搜索者主要使用邻接突变来导航配置空间,选择将本地结构扰动引入历史高性能基线的候选NCodes. 随着搜索的进行,利用这种邻里突变的概率逐渐降低,让位于利用历史背景的剥削模式. 至关重要的是,这种过渡适应目标任务的复杂性. 在更简单的NAS-Bench-201图像分级基准上,搜索器逐渐转向了定位安能策略,表明在关键地貌位置上固定特定高产模块的已学习出的趋势. 相反地,在高度复杂的GenEval文本到图像合成任务上,模型逐渐转向了Combital协同. 通过关注NCodes内部的多位数模式,它显示出能够解开各种配置的复杂组合效应.

blocks.en: Furthermore, the trajectory of Global Component Distribution, wherein the searcher evaluates configurations based on the macro-level frequency of specific operational digits rather than their absolute positions, reveals distinct adaptations. In the homogeneous NAS-Bench-201 search, the utilization of this strategy progressively intensifies, scaling up from an initial 10% to nearly 20%. In sharp contrast, for the heterogeneous GenEval task, this pattern is kept consistently subdued, hovering steadily at a probability of approximately 5%. This divergence offers compelling evidence of the system’s open-world generalizability: while the model learns to capitalize on global frequency heuristics as a stable descriptor for homogeneous model architecture search, it correctly recognizes that joint optimization across architecture, data, and hyperparameters demands a strict departure from simple global counting. Ultimately, these dynamics demonstrate that the LLM-based searcher does not merely memorize patterns; rather, it effectively navigates search spaces by adaptively combining different strategies to pinpoint optimal configurations.
blocks.zh: 此外,全球组件分配的轨迹,即搜索者根据特定操作数字的宏观频率而不是其绝对位置来评价配置,揭示出不同的调整。 在同质的NAS-Bench-201搜索中,这一策略的利用逐渐增强,从最初的10%扩大到了近20%。 与此形成鲜明对照的是,对于千差万别的GenEval任务来说,这种模式始终保持平稳,并稳步地徘徊,概率约为5%。 这一差异为系统开放世界的通俗性提供了令人信服的证据:虽然模型学习了利用全球频率高程作为单一模型结构搜索的稳定描述符,但它正确地认识到,跨结构、数据和超参数的联合优化要求严格偏离简单的全球计数。 归根结底,这些动态表明基于LLM的搜索器不仅会记住模式;相反,它通过适应性地结合不同的策略来确定最佳配置来有效导航搜索空间.

blocks.en: IV-G Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: IV-G 读取研究

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of our approach and the resulting configurations, we compared our method against several baselines. As shown in Table IV-F2 , our joint architecture and hyperparameter search approach outperforms both architecture-only search and hyperparameter/data-ratio-only search by overall scores of 0.05 and 0.02, respectively. This highlights the critical importance of jointly optimizing model architectures, training hyperparameters, and data ratios. Furthermore, when applying the searched AutoML configurations without the searched architecture or without the hyperparameter and data configurations (reverting to manually designed baselines), the overall score drops by 0.07 and 0.09, respectively. These results demonstrate that our LLM-based searcher successfully navigates the optimal combination of all configurations, rather than treating their optimization as isolated problems.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们的方法和由此产生的配置的有效性,我们把我们的方法与几个基线进行比较。 如表IV-F2所示,我们的联合建筑和超参数搜索方法分别以0.05分和0.02分的总分超过仅以建筑为主的搜索和高参数/数据为主的搜索。 这突出了联合优化模型结构、培训超参数和数据比率的极端重要性。 此外,在没有被搜索架构或没有超参数和数据配置(恢复到手动设计的基线)的情况下应用被搜索的自动ML配置时,总体分数分别下降0.07分和0.09分. 这些结果显示,我们基于LLM的搜索器成功导航了所有配置的最佳组合,而不是把它们的优化视为孤立的问题.

blocks.en: Furthermore, to investigate the efficacy of the key components within our framework and evaluate the impact of different LLM backbones, we conduct a comprehensive ablation study on the NAS-Bench-201 benchmark (table IV-F2 ). As delineated in Table IV-F2 , removing the pruning-based architecture sampling strategy ( w/o pruning-based sample) incurs a noticeable performance degradation across all three datasets (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet16-120), validating its critical role in augmenting trajectory diversity and structural distribution. More significantly, when disabling the objective reframing mechanism ( w/o objective reframing) and forcing the model to directly generate full NCodes rather than ranking candidates, we observe a catastrophic performance collapse (e.g., the test accuracy on ImageNet16-120 plummets from 46.51% to 42.53%). This sharp decline firmly demonstrates that reframing the discrete optimization into a tractable ranking task substantially alleviates the learning burden of the LLM searcher.
blocks.zh: 此外,为了调查我们框架内关键组成部分的功效并评价不同LLM主干线的影响,我们对NAS-Bench-201基准(表IV-F2)进行全面的扩展研究。 如表IV-F2所描述的,去除以穿透为主的结构取样战略(w/o穿透为主的样本),使所有三个数据集(CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet16-120)的性能明显退化,验证了它在增强轨迹多样性和结构分布方面的关键作用。 更为重要的是,当使目标再生机制(w/o目标再生机制)失效并迫使模型直接生成完整的NCodes而不是排名候选人时,我们看到灾难性的性能崩溃(例如ImageNet16-120上的测试精度从46.51%下降到42.53%). 这种急剧下降的情况坚定地表明,将离散优化调整为可拉动的排名任务可大大地减轻LLM搜索器的学习负担。

blocks.en: In addition, we compare the search efficiency of the LLM-based searchers built upon LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B. The empirical results indicate that both models achieve highly comparable and competitive performance across all validation and test sets (e.g., reaching 72.96% and 73.13% test accuracy on CIFAR-100, respectively). This comparable performance proves that instilling Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning capabilities via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) does not jeopardize the core optimization efficacy. To optimize overall search efficiency and circumvent the substantial computational overhead associated with token-heavy CoT generation, we deploy the LLaMA-3.1-8B searcher to execute all primary search environments reported in this study. Concurrently, the Qwen3-8B searcher is leveraged exclusively for the interpretability analysis to unpack and systematically interpret the internal decision-making mechanisms and temporal strategic transitions of the universal search agent.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们比较了基于LLM的搜索器基于LLaMA-3.1-8B和Qune3-8B的搜索效率. 经验结果表明,两种模型在所有验证和测试组中都取得了高度可比性和竞争性的性能(例如,CIFAR-100的测试精度分别达到72.96%和73.13%)。 这种可比较的业绩证明,通过集团相对政策优化(GRPO)灌输思维链(COT)推理能力不会损害核心优化效果. 为了优化整体搜索效率并避免与象征性重联T生成相关的大量计算间接费用,我们部署了LLaMA-31-8B搜索器,以执行本研究中报告的所有主要搜索环境. 同时,Qune3-8B搜索器专门用于解释性分析,以解开和系统解释通用搜索代理的内部决策机制和时间战略过渡.

blocks.en: IV-H Case Studies
blocks.zh: IV-H 案例研究

blocks.en: To further evaluate the fine-grained compositional text-to-image alignment of our optimized Diffusion Transformer, we present qualitative case studies comparing our method against the 12-billion-parameter FLUX.1-dev [ 27 ] and the AutoML approach OptFormer [ 9 ] . As illustrated in Fig. 8 , our method demonstrates superior semantic understanding and instruction adherence across complex compositional prompts involving coloring, attribute binding, and spatial relationships
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价我们最优化的传播变形器的精细成份文本与图像的相接性,我们提出了定性案例研究,将我们的方法与12亿参数FLUX.1-dev [27] 和自动ML方法OptFormer [9] 相比较. 如图8所示,我们的方法表明,在涉及彩色、属性约束和空间关系的复杂组成提示中,对语义的理解和指令的遵守程度更高。

blocks.en: Specifically, in the first two columns evaluating color attribute binding, FLUX.1-dev struggles to overcome strong visual priors and assign atypical colors to objects. It generates a standard orange instead of the requested ”red orange” and defaults to a standard red stop sign despite the prompt explicitly specifying a ”white stop sign”. In contrast, our method faithfully adheres to the instructions, rendering both the red orange and the white stop sign accurately. In the third column (”a photo of a purple wine glass and a black apple”), FLUX.1-dev misinterprets the attribute binding by applying the purple color to the liquid wine rather than the glass itself. Conversely, our model successfully disentangles these concepts to generate a purple-tinted glass.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,在评价色彩属性绑定的前两列中,FLUX.1-dev为克服强烈的视觉前科并给对象分配非典型色彩而挣扎. 它生成一个标准的橙色,而不是所要求的“红色橙色”并默认为标准红色停站标志,尽管迅速明确指定了一个“白色停站标志”。 相形之下,我们的方法忠实地遵守指示,使红橙和白止号都准确. 在第三栏("一幅紫酒玻璃和一幅黑苹果相片")中,FLUX.1-dev通过将紫色应用到液态葡萄酒而不是玻璃本身来曲解属性绑定. 反之,我们的模型成功地解开这些概念,生成出紫丁酸玻璃.

blocks.en: Furthermore, our method excels in understanding spatial dynamics and relational object associations. In the fourth column (”a photo of a vase right of a horse”), FLUX.1-dev fails to comprehend the distinct object relationship, suffering from concept bleeding where it erroneously generates a horse made of a porcelain material matching the vase. Similarly, in the fifth column (”a photo of a bird left of a couch”), FLUX.1-dev fails to reflect the correct relative spatial positioning requested by the user. Our model correctly captures these spatial and compositional dynamics in both instances. Finally, while OptFormer demonstrates a moderate degree of instruction adherence, it suffers from severe geometric distortions and a lack of photorealism. For instance, OptFormer generates a horse missing a leg (Column 4) and produces severely deformed, unrealistic couch structures (Column 5). These qualitative results underscore our LLM-based search framework’s ability to discover model configurations that yield high-fidelity, photorealistic, and highly instruction-compliant visual generations.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们的方法在理解空间动力学和关系物体关联方面非常出色。 FLUX.1-dev在第四栏(“一匹马的花瓶权利照片”)中未能理解不同的物体关系,在错误地产生出一匹与花瓶相匹配的花瓶相匹配的花瓶材料所制成的一匹马时,概念会出血。 同样地,在第五栏("沙发上留下的鸟的照片")中,FLUX.1-dev未能反映用户所要求的正确的相对空间定位. 我们的模型正确地捕捉了这两种情况下的空间和组成动态。 最后,OptFormer虽然表现出了中等程度的对指令的坚持度,但是它遭受了严重的几何扭曲和缺乏光现实主义. 例如,OptFormer生成一匹马缺失一腿(Column 4)并产生严重变形,不切实际的沙发结构(Column 5). 这些质量结果凸显出我们基于LLM的搜索框架能够发现能够产生高真实性、光现实性和高度符合指令的视觉世代的模型配置。

blocks.en: V Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 五. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented a universal LLM-based AutoML framework designed to jointly optimize model architectures, training hyperparameters, and data ratios across open-world scenarios without task-specific fine-tuning. By introducing NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme, we mapped heterogeneous design choices into universal discrete sequences and reframed the optimization process as a conditional candidate ranking problem. Trained exclusively on trajectory data curated from a single-domain vision dataset, our searcher demonstrated remarkable zero-shot generalizability across seven domains, four tasks, and three modalities (vision, text, and audio). Experimental results validated its state-of-the-art efficiency and scalability, notably optimizing a 1.3-billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer to attain a GenEval score of 0.91.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了一个通用的基于LLM的AutoML框架,旨在共同优化模型架构,培训超参数,以及跨开放世界情景的数据比率,而无需针对特定任务的微调. 通过引入NCode,一个统一的数字编码方案,我们将各种设计选择映射到通用的离散序列中,并将优化过程重新设定为有条件的候选人排名问题. 我们的搜索员专门从一个单一域的视野数据集中培训出轨迹数据,显示在7个领域、4个任务和3个模式(视觉、文字和音频)中具有显著的零射通俗性。 实验结果验证了其最先进的效率和可伸缩性,特别是优化了13亿参数的分散变压器,以达到GenEval分数0.91.

blocks.en: Furthermore, by instilling Chain-of-Thought reasoning through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), we demystified the searcher’s internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing an adaptive transition from early-stage diversity-driven exploration to late-stage anchor exploitation. This work establishes a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward autonomous, general-purpose machine learning optimization. Future work will explore extending the searcher to Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to integrate direct visual rewards for richer generative quality assessment.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们通过集团相对政策优化(GRPO)灌输思维链推理,解密了搜索者的内部决策机制,揭示了从由多样性驱动的早期探索向后期锚地开发的适应性转变。 这项工作确定了实现自主通用机器学习优化的可扩展、可概括和可解释的途径。 今后的工作将探索将搜索器扩展到Vision-Langage Models(VLMs),将直接视觉奖励纳入更丰富的基因质量评估.
